# Smart Home Devices: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation; apps, firmware, and account settings change often, and
vendors end cloud services with limited notice. Re-verify links and contents when updating this skill.

Last verified: 2026-10-30

## Vendor (authoritative)

### DIY and open firmware

- ESPHome native API (port, `encryption` key): https://esphome.io/components/api/
- ESPHome OTA (`encryption` vs. legacy `password`, default ports, plaintext risks):
  https://esphome.io/components/ota/esphome/
- ESPHome web server (`auth`, web server OTA): https://esphome.io/components/web_server.html
- ESPHome changelog (for example API password removal in 2026.1.0): https://esphome.io/changelog/
- ESPHome security advisories: https://github.com/esphome/esphome/security/advisories
- Tasmota, securing devices (web server, MQTT, fallback AP): https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Securing-your-IoT-from-hacking/
- Tasmota commands (`WebPassword`, `Webserver`, `WifiConfig`): https://tasmota.github.io/docs/Commands/
- Shelly Gen2+ authentication (digest, `Shelly.SetAuth`, unprotected endpoints):
  https://shelly-api-docs.shelly.cloud/gen2/General/Authentication
- Shelly Gen1 HTTP API (authentication disabled by default, `/settings/login`):
  https://shelly-api-docs.shelly.cloud/gen1/

### Hubs, bridges, and radio protocols

- Philips Hue developer documentation (local API, link-button authorization, discovery; free registration
  needed for some pages): https://developers.meethue.com/develop/get-started-2/
- Zigbee2MQTT network settings (default network key, PAN ID, `GENERATE`):
  https://www.zigbee2mqtt.io/guide/configuration/zigbee-network.html
- Silicon Labs AN1089, Zigbee installation codes:
  https://www.silabs.com/documents/public/application-notes/an1089-using-installation-codes-with-zigbee-devices.pdf
- Silicon Labs, Z-Wave security (S2 classes, Access Control for locks and garage doors):
  https://www.silabs.com/whitepapers/z-wave-security
- Z-Wave Alliance (specifications and certification): https://z-wavealliance.org/

### Matter and Thread

- Connectivity Standards Alliance, Matter: https://csa-iot.org/all-solutions/matter/
- CSA Matter security and privacy one-pager:
  https://csa-iot.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Matter-Security-Privacy_one-pager.pdf
- Matter handbook, security and discovery (DNS-SD service types):
  https://handbook.buildwithmatter.com/howitworks/security and
  https://handbook.buildwithmatter.com/howitworks/discovery
- Google Home developers, commissionable and operational discovery:
  https://developers.home.google.com/matter/primer/commissionable-and-operational-discovery
- Amazon, Matter commissioning best practices (commissioning windows, multi-admin):
  https://developer.amazon.com/docs/alexaplus/smarthome/best-practices-commission-matter
- Thread Group: https://www.threadgroup.org/
- OpenThread border router guides: https://openthread.io/guides/border-router

### Vendor lifecycle example

- Belkin, Wemo support ending (cloud and app shutdown 2026-01-31): https://www.belkin.com/support/wemo

### Regulators and labeling

- UK Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure (PSTI) product security regime:
  https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-uk-product-security-and-telecommunications-infrastructure-product-security-regime
- US FCC Cyber Trust Mark (voluntary IoT label; check current rollout status):
  https://www.fcc.gov/cybertrustmark
- ETSI EN 303 645, consumer IoT security baseline: https://www.etsi.org/technologies/consumer-iot-security

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- TechCrunch, Ecovacs robot vulnerabilities presented at DEF CON 2024 (camera/microphone access, access
  after resale): https://techcrunch.com/2024/08/22/ecovacs-says-it-will-fix-bugs-that-can-be-abused-to-spy-on-robot-owners
  Useful as an example of robot-vacuum risks; check the vendor's current advisories for fix status.
- TechCrunch, Amazon Echo "Do Not Send Voice Recordings" option removed 2025-03-28:
  https://techcrunch.com/2025/03/15/amazons-echo-will-send-all-voice-recordings-to-the-cloud-starting-march-28
  Check Amazon's current privacy settings pages for present options.
- Nextgov, US Cyber Trust Mark rollout status (October 2026):
  https://www.nextgov.com/cybersecurity/2026/10/fcc-commissioner-hopes-cyber-trust-mark-products-reach-shoppers-within-year/416878/
- aioesphomeapi (Home Assistant's ESPHome client library; notes the API password removal):
  https://pypi.org/project/aioesphomeapi/
